document.title: Install ripgrep for the eval workflow
document.summary: The eval workflow installs ripgrep before the graded run so the Cursor SDK can find rg on PATH.
document.why: The package walk is heavier than this repo wants. [The request](source:s1) asks to install ripgrep in the eval workflow when the SDK finds rg on PATH.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 27
sources.gist: Install ripgrep in the eval workflow if the SDK finds rg on PATH, and drop the resolver.

groups.title: Ripgrep on the eval runner
groups.why: [The request](source:s1) asks for apt install of ripgrep in the eval workflow, not a path resolver.
groups.summary: The workflow runs sudo apt-get install -y ripgrep before the graded eval.

commits.subject: Install ripgrep in the eval workflow
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The Cursor SDK finds rg on PATH and calls configureRipgrepPath.
ubuntu-latest has no rg, so ignore scans log the missing-path error.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Point Cursor eval agents at the bundled ripgrep
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The SDK does not export configureRipgrepPath. On local startup it
reads an absolute CURSOR_RIPGREP_PATH and calls that function. pnpm
does not put the platform package rg where the SDK searches, and
GitHub runners have no rg on PATH, so ignore scans log the error.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
